question: Should post-auth Gateway close-on-timeout keepalive be default-on for existing users, or should it land as an opt-in compatibility mode first?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible fix for the stale-peer gap, but the default changes existing omitted-config behavior and may close live sockets on missed or delayed pongs.

options.title: Make timeout close opt-in first
options.body: Keep current ping-only compatibility by default and let operators enable close-on-timeout with `gateway.keepalive` until live upgrade proof supports a stronger default.

options.title: Approve default-on with proof
options.body: Accept the behavior change only after the PR provides real Gateway/client proof and documents the upgrade impact for existing deployments.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and replace this branch if rebasing and proof collection would cost more than a narrow maintainer-owned fix.

recommendation.title: Make timeout close opt-in first
recommendation.body: Keep current ping-only compatibility by default and let operators enable close-on-timeout with `gateway.keepalive` until live upgrade proof supports a stronger default.
